issues.description: Field 'lectureName': the UML in the problem statement declares lectureName as type int, while the solution implementation declares the field as a String and the template expects the student to add the attribute. Specifically: problem_statement.md UML shows "-lectureName: int" (line 64); solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java declares "private String lectureName;" (line 6); template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java contains a TODO placeholder where the attribute should be added (line 4). This contradiction (int vs String) can confuse students which type to implement and may lead to incorrect implementations or mismatch with the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare lectureName as a String (e.g. lectureName: String) so it matches the intended design and the solution implementation. Also update any textual references to lectureName in the problem statement. After that, verify the remaining attribute types in the UML (numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) to ensure they are declared as int as in the solution.
